conventions.workflow_lens_labels: A review workflow's lens contexts are registered as claude-code-workflow:<run>:<agentId>:<record>-review-lens-<lens>-01 while the workflow journal labels the same agent ids review:<lens>; the agent id is the identity, the label is descriptive (applies to closures 157 and 159; stated here per the record-10 review nit).
conventions.workflow_agent_labels: From closure 175 on, a workflow agent is registered as claude-code-workflow:<run>:<agentId>:<label>-<form>, where <label> is the CODE RED label the workflow ran under; the forms, with the workflow journal's label in brackets: a review's lens <label>-review-lens-<lens>-01 [review:<lens>] and refuter <label>-review-refute-<lens>-<finding>-NN [refute:<lens>:<FINDING>:<N>], the finding id lowercased and NN the refuter's number in two digits; a delta review's lens and refuter the same with delta-review in place of review; a fact-check's checker <label>-factcheck-<checker>-01 [factcheck:<checker>]; a design workflow's designer <label>-design-<angle>-01 [design:<angle>] and synthesizer <label>-synthesize-<kind>-01 [synthesize:<kind>]. As in workflow_lens_labels, the agent id is the identity and the form is descriptive; an id already registered keeps the form it was registered with (closures 173 and 174 used other forms for design, refuter and synthesis agents). Stated here as DECISIONS-24 promised.
